title: bug: HMAC C_Sign size-query leaves operation active (PKCS#11 violation)
description: In C_Sign(), when pSignature==NULL (size-query per PKCS#11 2.40 sec.11.11), the HMAC path returns the output size but leaves s->sign_active=1. PKCS#11 spec says size-query is an ordinary completion: the operation must be terminated. Consequence: next C_SignInit fails with CKR_OPERATION_ACTIVE. Asymmetric path correctly terminates. Fix: clear s->sign_active before returning on HMAC size-query.
